### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues are reported for the Mistral seed-parameter mapping change. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR This PR fixes seed handling in the Python Mistral AI connector by sending the SDK-supported `random_seed` parameter instead of `seed`. **Changes:** - Maps `seed` to `random_seed`, preserving an explicitly supplied `random_seed`. - Adds unit tests for seed mapping and explicit-value precedence. - Updates streaming and non-streaming service tests to expect `random_seed`. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `python/​tests/​unit/​connectors/​ai/​mistral_ai/​test_mistralai_request_settings.py` | Adds seed mapping and precedence tests. | | `python/​tests/​unit/​connectors/​ai/​mistral_ai/​services/​test_mistralai_chat_completion.py` | Updates expected SDK arguments for both completion modes. | | `python/​semantic_kernel/​connectors/​ai/​mistral_ai/​prompt_execution_settings/​mistral_ai_prompt_execution_settings.py` | Converts `seed` to `random_seed` when preparing request settings. |
Review effort: Balanced
